filters_note: Filters only hide rows. Ranks, bounds and normalization anchors are those of the full run, so a rank may skip numbers in a filtered list.

anchors.name: activity_scale
anchors.transformation: log1p of the value floored at 0, then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling

manifest.tie_rule: exact numeric score descending, then school name ascending in Unicode code point order

persistence.limitation: These numbers come from an experiment that included urgency, so they describe the circulated rule only. They are not a result of the proposed rule that leaves urgency out.
persistence.threshold_adjacent_rule: A persistent school is threshold-adjacent when its lowest frequency is less than one standard error above the threshold. The standard error is sqrt(threshold * (1 - threshold) / draws), the Monte Carlo error of a frequency at the threshold, so such a school could fall below the line on another run of the draws.
